name: @seat/server
description: Fastify API implementing docs/api.md and the invariants in docs/domain-model.md (decision 0006).

scripts.build: prisma generate && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/server.ts src/seed.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --packages=external --alias:@seat/shared=../shared/src/index.ts --outdir=dist --log-level=warning
scripts.db:reset: prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed && npm run db:seed
